items.note: STATUS CHANGED 2026-09-02 (was verified_gold / usable_for_official_metrics=true). OCR-confirmed 2026-09-01: this reference is CIRCULAR - ground_truth/1252_1000016397_76.8s_burned.mp4 reproduces the gold SRT verbatim, because it is the render Curify itself produced from the same outreach translation to email the submitter. items.production_direction: RESOLVED 2026-08-30. Title cards read 'Certificate Program for Sign Language Interpreters - RECEPTIVE SKILLS EVALUATION' / 'SIGN TO VOICE' / 'Record yourself voicing the video'. An interpreter certification exercise: the ASL is the source and the captions are the answer key. This was the blocker recorded in the spec as SS9.5; it no longer applies. What remains is an annotator confirming the caption text against the actual signing.
